interfaces.getL1Fee: Unsigned fully RLP-encoded transaction; oracle adds signature overhead.
interfaces.getL1FeeUpperBound: Unsigned RLP size; Fjord-supported practical compression estimator, not an absolute future-fee bound.
interfaces.getOperatorFee: The oracle chooses its own pre-Isthmus/Isthmus/Jovian behavior; implementation does not duplicate a formula.

chain_access: No public chain/RPC requests made for this qualification. Existing configured ChainClient transport only in implementation; tests use controlled transports and local Anvil.
